The '''Aldino sector''' was a sector in the southwestern [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It bordered [[Elbaran sector/Legends|Elbaran]], [[Almak sector/Legends|Almak]] and [[Graador sector/Legends|Graador sectors]] in the Mid Rim, as well as [[Wazta sector/Legends|Wazta sector]] and a tiny sliver of [[Bri'ahl sector/Legends|Bri'ahl sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
